各位老師好，我是鄭江宇。目前任職於東吳大學資料科學系，最高學歷是中央大學資訊管理博士。我的研究與教學一路都圍繞資訊管理核心問題發展：科技如何改變企業、平台與使用者之間的資訊互動。近年則聚焦在生成式 AI 治理、數位平台資料分析與電子商務。

核心問題始終一致：資訊科技如何改變企業、平台與使用者之間的資訊互動？
我的研究不是因為生成式 AI 出現才突然轉向。早期從電子商務與消費者行為開始，之後進入網站流量與 Web Analytics，再延伸到數位平台、網路資料取得與治理。生成式 AI 出現後，剛好把這些既有基礎串在一起，所以現在自然延伸到 AI crawler、生成式搜尋與電子商務資訊治理。

研究探索→產業應用→教材轉譯→課程教學→人才培育
教學上，我比較重視學生能不能真的理解、應用，而不是只完成考試。過去兩度獲教育部教學實踐研究計畫支持，一次是程式設計團隊合作，這一次則是生成式 AI 識辯素養。另外我長期寫教材與專業書，國家圖書館可查到九筆出版紀錄。我的習慣是把研究和產業經驗再轉回教材與課程。

把個人經驗轉化為系上可以共同累積、長期延續的教研能量。
如果有機會加入高科大，我最希望強調的是互補，而不是重複。我可以把自己在生成式 AI 治理、平台資料分析與電子商務的經驗接到系上既有的 AI、資安、資料分析、系統開發與管理專長。無論研究、課程、產學或學生培育，我都希望以共同合作為主。

English Micro-Teaching0:55–1:40
When we focus on one thing,
we may miss something else.
Even when it is right in front of us.
This is called selective attention.
And the same thing can happen when people use a website.
Some of you saw it. Some of you probably didn’t. And that’s the interesting part. This is called selective attention. When we focus on one thing, we may miss something else, even when it’s right there. And the same thing can happen when people use a website. There are pictures, buttons, menus, text, maybe some promotions. But users are not paying attention to everything. So, how do we know what they actually do?

English Micro-Teaching1:40–3:35

Microsoft Clarity Click Heatmap

Not eye tracking — it shows where people actually click.
8,088 page views11,361 clickstop item: 2,564 clicks
One way is to look at a heatmap. This is a click heatmap from Microsoft Clarity. It’s pretty easy to read. Red means people click there a lot. Blue means they don’t click there very much. So, right away, we can see which parts of the page get more interaction. Just one thing to keep in mind: this is not eye tracking. It doesn’t tell us exactly where people are looking. It tells us where they actually click. This page has more than eight thousand page views and over eleven thousand clicks. If you were managing this website, where would you look first? Probably the red areas, right?
Clarity Heatmap11
English Micro-Teaching3:35–5:00

From Clicks to Better Decisions

What if an important button
gets very few clicks?
Maybe people don’t notice it.Maybe it’s in the wrong place.Maybe the wording isn’t clear.Or maybe they just don’t care about it.
People don’t notice everything.Heatmaps help us ask better questions about what users actually do.Use data to make better decisions.
But I think the more interesting question is: what if an important button gets very few clicks? Maybe people don’t notice it. Maybe it’s in the wrong place. Maybe the wording isn’t clear. Or maybe they just don’t care about it. And that’s where the heatmap becomes useful. It helps us ask better questions. Then we can change the page, test a new design, and see what happens. So, the main idea today is really simple. People don’t notice everything. Good analytics is not just about collecting data. It’s about using that data to make better decisions. Thank you.

Q&A 備用頁7 min
Q
為什麼想加入高科大資管系？

希望把既有研究、教學、教材與產學經驗放進更強調跨領域協作與產業連結的環境，並和系上現有專長形成互補。

Q
可以立即開哪些課？

網站流量分析與數位決策、Python 網路資料擷取與分析、生成式 AI 搜尋與電子商務、AI 搜尋與數位內容治理、數位平台資料分析。

Q
未來 3–5 年研究？

AI 資料取得 → 生成式搜尋 → 資訊可見性 → 數位治理 → 電子商務，並透過跨教師合作爭取國科會、產學與國際合作。

Q
能帶來什麼產學資源？

既有數據平台、網站流量、爬蟲與資料治理合作經驗，可把企業生成式 AI 導入問題拆成跨領域合作題目。

Q&A 不要背長答案。每題控制 40 到 60 秒。先回答結論，再用一個既有成果當證據，最後回到高科大資管系可以如何合作。
